review_scope: Actual frozen implementation source/data/docs, finite focused gate receipts, real ARM HAL library archives and linked application ELF artifacts. Runtime lifecycle is reviewed separately; no hardware execution is claimed.

toolchain.build_mode: release, locked, offline, no default features; one shared main target used serially; artifacts and OUT_DIR retained per row

development_alias_correction.reason: Own L031 LINEN/BRKLEN control spellings differ from canonical normalized names outside this receive-source equality boundary.
development_alias_correction.reviewed_resolution: Full own IER/ISR/ICR/RDR and RXEN/OVER checks; full canonical YAML/JSON profiles remain strict.

limits: Static source review and a source-checker pass do not establish runtime execution.
13 exact selection library builds do not mean every one of 54 selections or all routes was built.
No silicon loss rate, interrupt saturation, RTS timing, throughput, runtime stack depth or bounded completion qualification.
Software BufferOverflow and native ORE are distinct; ten families can overwrite RDR silently before ISR service.
RTS follows hardware RC rather than software ring occupancy.
Accepted-main does not imply clean acceptance or publication.
